relevance.rationale: JOIN CONFIRMED against the document's front matter. THE LOAD-BEARING CITATION CHECKS OUT EXACTLY. `WindingGFTransform.lean:19` calls eq. C.7 'the DGG quantum A-polynomial annihilator' and carries it as the conditional class `FourOneIndexAnnihilated`. Appendix C confirms it verbatim: eq. (C.7) is introduced and then described as 'The quantum Lagrangian (C.7) is well known in knot theory and Chern-Simons theory as the "quantum A-polynomial" of the figure-eight knot', with the complementary '−' operator obtained from it by M̂ → M̂₋, ℓ̂ → ℓ̂₋. The file's §3b-cond handling is honest — it labels the annihilator 'a cited literature input, NOT proved here' and makes everything downstream carry it as a hypothesis. TWO DEFECTS AT THAT ONE SITE, both in the Ref: block. (a) `WindingGFTransform.lean:47` attaches an identifier to this key that is not the one registered for it and that belongs to a different journal series. (b) The very next line, `WindingGFTransform.lean:48`, writes `-- Ref: [garoufalidis-gu-marino2021] GGM 2012.00062` — but arXiv 2012.00062 is the peacock paper, registered under the DIFFERENT key `garoufalidis-gu-marino2023peacock`; the key `garoufalidis-gu-marino2021` is registered against a different arXiv id entirely. The site attaches one work's arXiv id to another work's key.
